scripts.music: node scripts/music.mjs && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i public/music.raw.wav -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=11 -ar 48000 public/music.wav
scripts.render: npm run render:square && npm run render:wide
scripts.render:square: remotion render src/index.ts Square out/dashcraft-square.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:wide: remotion render src/index.ts Wide out/dashcraft-wide.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
